quotes.author: Jacob Housley
quotes.text: Chris is a great guide! We booked him for an 8 hour trip in early November and we had the best time ever! Not only did he get all 4 of us limited on speckled trout, we caught sheepsheads, redfish, whitefish, and black drums. What a blast and a reasonable price too! Thank you Chris, we will see you in March!

quotes.author: John Burkes
quotes.text: Best guide I've been with since I started taking both of my boys now 16 and 12 years old saltwater fishing. Captain Chris put us on the fish! Was patient and took the time to explain to my boys what they needed to do to be successful in hooking the fish. We had a great mix Trout, black drum, and Reds.

quotes.author: Mike Bedard
quotes.text: My wife and I booked a half day with Chris. We had an amazing day on the water! We are new to the area and Chris was extremely helpful and patient with us. We caught 6 species of fish and brought home some great table fare. We would recommend Chris to anyone fishing in the Galveston area!

quotes.author: Tony Gibson
quotes.text: We had a great trip with Captain Chris. He had great communication leading up to our trip. Is very knowledgeable and put us on the fish! Do not hesitate to book! We had a great morning on the water.

quotes.author: Christopher Colvert
quotes.text: Amazing fishing experience! Captain Chris knew where the big fish were and put me on some amazing fish! Would definitely recommend to anyone and I will for sure be coming back.

quotes.author: Paul Phillips
quotes.text: Fantastic trip with Captain Chris. He kept our reels singing all day long! There’s a difference between fishing and catching fish. This man puts you on the fish!!

quotes.author: Blake Powerlift
quotes.text: Chris put us on the fish! Drum, trout and redfish. Trip cut a little short because of storms but still had a blast!
